_note: Episode 37 (S4E6), story version 2, Kabanata 37 "Saksi Ako". Manila and Kawit, present day; Indio 35, strings as in Episode 34 (dark suit with no tie at the hearing). Witness scenes: a parking garage two years earlier (the handover seen from behind a pillar, both faces turned away) and the shore of Laguna de Bay in the year 900 (a reconstruction: the plate handed to a family, small figures far away; the real place of issue is unknown). The hearing, committee, senator, undersecretary, judge, firm and every paper are invented; name plates, screens and forms carry only scribbles; no real seal. Sinag wears Tubal's face. Shots follow sentences.json; the Bible pages carry no readable text; sentence 5 reuses list_hand; k90 is a montage extra.
